u1.title: More reading · A long life of giving

data.问题: What can we learn from Madam Li's story?

data.问题: What do we do when we meet a friend?

data.答案: We put our hands up to protect our face.

data.问题: What is body language?
data.答案: Using your body — face, hands, posture — to communicate without words.

data.问题: Why does the passage say 'our body speaks for us'?
data.答案: Because body language can express feelings even without words.

u2.title: Grammar focus · Linking words: so / because / but

data.问题: Join: I smiled. I was happy. (because)
data.答案: I smiled because I was happy.

data.问题: Join: He was tired. He went to bed early. (so)
data.答案: He was tired, so he went to bed early.

data.问题: Join: She wanted to speak. She was too shy. (but)
data.答案: She wanted to speak, but she was too shy.

data.问题: What does thumbs up mean in China and most Western countries?

data.答案: Different things — a gesture can have opposite meanings.

data.问题: Why is it important to understand gestures in different cultures?
data.答案: To avoid misunderstandings when travelling or communicating.

data.问题: What is the main message of this passage?
data.答案: Gestures are not universal; always learn local customs.

u3.title: Grammar focus · Used to / be used to

data.问题: Fill in: Grandma ___ (used to) cut paper every morning.
Fill in: I ___ (used to) be afraid of the dark.
Fill in: She ___ (be used to) getting up early now.
What is the difference between 'used to' and 'be used to'?
data.答案: 'Used to' = past habit no longer true; 'be used to' = accustomed to something now.

u3.title: More reading · Why save old skills?

data.问题: Name three traditional skills mentioned.
data.答案: Embroidery from Suzhou, porcelain from Jingdezhen, kites from Weifang, tea from Hangzhou.

data.问题: Why are traditional skills in danger?
data.答案: Because fewer young people are learning them.

data.问题: What do traditional skills carry?
data.答案: The history and culture of a place.

data.问题: What can we infer about the future of traditional skills?
data.答案: They may disappear if we don't make efforts to protect and pass them on.

data.问题: How tall is Buddy?

data.答案: In factories — they build cars, pack milk and sort packages.

data.问题: Where else are robots used besides factories?
data.答案: In hospitals for surgery, and in homes as vacuum cleaners.

data.问题: What is the advantage of robots in factories?
data.答案: They can work 24 hours without getting tired and make fewer mistakes.

data.问题: What can we infer about robots' future role?
data.答案: Robots will take over more jobs, but humans will still be needed for creative work.
